metadata.case_name: LI WING KWAI v. CHAN HAU YU

injuries.description: Impingement syndrome and tendinosis or partial tear of the supraspinatus tendon (right shoulder)
source: “The cause of the persistent pain of her right shoulder was impingement syndrome and tendinosis or partial tear of the supraspinatus tendon.”
injuries.icd_description: Other specified injury of muscle or tendon of the rotator cuff of shoulder

injuries.description: Soft tissue contusion injury to left elbow/wrist and dorsal aspect of left hand
injuries.body_part: left elbow/wrist and dorsal aspect of left hand
source: “The diagnosiswas soft tissue contusion injury to her left elbow/wrist, dorsal aspect of left hand as well as her right shoulder.”
“Physical examination showed redness over left wrist and face. X-ray of left wrist showed no abnormality.”
injuries.icd_description: Multiple superficial injuries of wrist or hand

injuries.description: Contusion / sprain / ligament injury of left thumb (metacarpophalangeal joint)
source: “crushing injury to left thumb. Examination revealed tenderness, redness and bruise marks over left hand. X-ray of left thumb showed no fracture. He was discharged home. He attended the A&ED again at about 5 pm on 27/2/11 for left thumb contusion when being assaulted on 26/2/2011. Examination revealed swelling and tenderness of left thumb... The diagnosis should be ‘contusion’ or ‘sprain’ of the left thumb. I consider the diagnosis of ligament injury made by the orthopaedic colleagues of AHNH to be appropriate.”
injuries.icd_description: Strain or sprain of metacarpophalangeal joint of thumb

manifestations.description: Redness over left wrist and face
Increased left elbow pain after the limb was pulled by someone on 26/2/2011
Mild degree of decreased efficiency at work due to residual pain in left elbow and right shoulder
Swelling and tenderness of left thumb; decreased range of movement; tenderness, redness and bruise marks over left hand
The present condition of his left hand should allow him to continue working as a TCM practitioner. Any decrease in his efficiency at work as a result of the left thumb injury should be minimal.

treatments_received: A&E attendance at Alice Ho Miu Ling Nethersole Hospital
physiotherapy sessions at Good Health Medical Centre
treatment by Registered Chinese Medicine Practitioner Mr Chan Chi Fi
clinic visits to Dr Anthony WL Lam and Dr Chan Man To Joseph

losses.description: Residual pain and decreased efficiency at work due to impingement syndrome and tendinosis/partial tear of the supraspinatus tendon (right shoulder) and contusion to left elbow/wrist.
Pain and reduced function of left thumb following contusion/sprain/ligament injury to left thumb.

losses.category: Loss of confidence in going out in the public
losses.description: Injury to pride and dignity caused by deliberate assault in public by Chan resulting in humiliation and injury to plaintiff's pride and dignity (aggravated damages awarded).
